notes.title: Performance, Polish, and Complexity Update
notes.notes:
- Inspected every level and cutscene and removed performance blockers. Generally, this meant removing all dynamic lighting and using light probes. Performance should be excellent when there is only 1 camera and not too bad when there are two cameras (e.g., ship overhead view). 
- We tweaked the lighting through the levels.
- We added some level complexity for the train level (final round has a train in every track) and the laser-rock level (again, lots more rocks of various colors). 
- We added a new voice-over artist from Taiwan for the pronunciation of complex characters. The original voice artist remains when selecting simplified characters.

notes.title: Update - Final Puzzle, Final Cut-Scene, 3 Volume Controls (SFX, Voice, Music)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]We added a final puzzle to the end of the game along with a final cut-scene explaining more of the story. The puzzle is available on the last level. 
[*]The puzzle is introduced at the end of the first section (level 14). The puzzle is updated at the end of each section with terms you just learned, until at the end, you can read the entire message, and make use of what you learn.
[*]We added 3 volume controls for SFX, Voice, and Music. You can crank up voice if you want to catch all the pronunciation really well and turn down SFX so that you don't get distracted.
[/list]
